metadata.title: Viet Nam motorways, trunk and primary roads, and railways (OpenStreetMap)

selection.clip: ways with no node inside the published provinces + 2 km margin dropped; ways are never cut

metadata.merge: ways sharing class, ref and name merged with shapely linemerge; ways with neither ref nor name kept separate
metadata.simplificationMethod: Douglas-Peucker, topology preserving (shapely simplify); vertices removed, never moved
metadata.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; extract: Geofabrik vietnam-260921.osm.pbf (2026-09-21)
metadata.accuracyNotice: OpenStreetMap is volunteer-mapped: coverage, tagging and names vary by area and date. Geometry is shown for orientation, not for engineering or cadastral use.
metadata.crs: OGC:CRS84 (longitude, latitude; equivalent datum to EPSG:4326)
metadata.lengthMethod: WGS84 geodesic (pyproj Geod) on the unsimplified OSM way
